title: Moran Janagosthi (মৰাণ জনগোষ্ঠী)
author: Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain (ড° বীৰেন্দ্ৰ কুমাৰ গোহাঁই)
description: Extensive anthropological and historical monograph by Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain on the Moran community of Upper Assam, examining early Ahom-Moran matrimonial ties, mutual military assistance, riverine settlements along the Burhi Dihing, and the shared geographic sphere with the Tai Khamyang of Powaimukh.
source: Guwahati: Assam Institute of Research for Tribals and Scheduled Castes, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.452043

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ၼႆႉ လၢတ်ႈ လွင်ႈ ပိုၼ်း လႄႈ လွင်ႈ ယူႇသဝ်း ၵိၼ် သၢင်ႈ ၶွင် ၵူၼ်း ၶိူဝ်း မူဝ်ႇရၢၼ်ႇ တီႈ ဢႃႇသမ်ႇ
sentences.text_roman: pap nai lat lawng poen lae lawng yu saw kin sang khawng khon khoer mo ran ti a sam

sentences.free_translation_en: This monograph presents an exhaustive ethnographic and historical investigation of the Moran community in Upper Assam.

sentences.notes: Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain's ethnographic research.

sentences.free_translation_en: Chao Sukaphaa wed Moran noblewomen, sealing an enduring diplomatic and familial alliance between the communities.
